name: Tamanna Crusch
source:
"I will use my body to the fullest to make that child ruler..."

The stepmother of Farasha, and the real mother of Safina. She was originally the queen of a rich neighboring country, but it was plundered when she caught the eye of King Crusch. She's naturally a kind-hearted woman, but her beautiful visage and voluptuous body easily seduces men, and even before she became the current queen, she was treated as a war trophy. As a result, the techniques of pleasing men are ingrained into her body.
